question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Dolphins, Sharks. Sea creatures
solution:
**Given:**

Dolphins, Sharks. Sea creatures

The Venn diagram for the given classes is:

Dolphins and sharks both are different sea creatures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57e5c29b071fff06e27d5b1ff4871dace197ff3d1d49be5fb80584a82de3a998.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Dolphins are part of the toothed whales. Generally, they are among the smaller whales. Most live in saltwater oceans, but some live in rivers – there are oceanic dolphins and river dolphins.
 
• Oceanic dolphins are marine animals living in the sea. They live in all of the oceans.
 
• Three of the four species of river dolphins live in freshwater rivers. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f339d8162946f5eefba947b4fe948c141652727cd6201a655fb2ac8c9fe6c909.png]
